Looping in a short vendor setup runbook so procurement knows the pieces. Quick items we typically need from Novus (so we can queue vendor setup):

- Completed vendor profile (company address, tax ID, W-9) — owner Novus procurement
- Internal PO number / billing contact to be provided by Novus finance
- Marketplace/vendor portal registration (we can provision the vendor account once W-9 + profile done)
- SOC2 snapshot + attestation link (we will point to our public security page but can provide direct evidence if required)

Estimated internal timeline (best case): vendor profile + W-9 received by 11/05 -> finance review 11/06–11/09 -> vendor portal live and test accounts 11/12.

I'll prep the vendor profile template and send to Cara today. If Novus needs 3rd-party onboarding forms filled, let us know and we will prioritize.

Marcus Lin

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few legal items that need explicit confirmation before we can accept your response:

- Data processing: our team requires the DPA be incorporated by reference into the MSA (not a separate click-through). Please confirm and provide the clause language you intend to rely on.
- Indemnity cap: Novus would like to align the cap to a 12‑month fee baseline rather than a flat amount — can Redwood accommodate?
- Subprocessors: Need automated notification for new subprocessors 30 days in advance.

I've attached our annotated redlines (see Novus_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf) and highlighted the DPA incorporation point. We can be flexible on the exact cap if there's a clear mitigation plan (insurance proof, cyber coverage).

Attachment: Novus_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf (pdf)

Regards,
